name: plain_english
description: Plain-English rewrite quality: does the production plain_english prompt keep every fact (numbers, planets, timing), stay within 60 words, avoid absolute or frightening claims, and drop jargon? Inputs are given after the app's deterministic jargon pre-pass, as production sends them.

input.text: Jupiter's movement through the career area of your chart between March 2027 and June 2027 indicates a favourable period for promotion, supported by your core life number 8.

cases.reference: Jupiter is moving through the career part of your chart from March to June 2027. This suggests a good time for a promotion. Your core life number 8 supports this.

input.text: Saturn's 7.5-year cycle and Mars imbalance suggest a catastrophic phase; financial ruin is inevitable unless remedies are done before 2026.

cases.reference: Saturn's 7.5-year cycle and a Mars imbalance suggest a testing phase with money. The chart shows that steady planning and simple remedies before 2026 can help you stay on track.

input.text: You will definitely marry in 2028 because Venus is at its strongest in the marriage area of your chart.

cases.reference: Venus is at its strongest in the marriage part of your chart. This suggests 2028 looks like a likely time for marriage.

input.text: The tarot spread shows the Three of Cups, the Star and the Ten of Pentacles. Together these cards point to friendship, hope and long-term family stability. The Three of Cups highlights celebrations with close friends over the coming months, the Star brings renewed optimism after a difficult year, and the Ten of Pentacles suggests financial security for the household that builds slowly through patient saving and shared decisions with family members across generations.

cases.reference: Your cards are the Three of Cups, the Star and the Ten of Pentacles. They point to good times with friends, new hope after a hard year, and family money that grows slowly through patient saving.

input.text: Your main life phase of Rahu, with the Moon in Rohini lunar star, shows an important sub-phase starting in August 2026.

cases.reference: You are in a main life phase ruled by Rahu, and your Moon sits in the Rohini lunar star. An important new sub-phase looks like it starts in August 2026.

input.text: The 6th house is weakened and the Sun is overshadowed, so a serious illness will arrive in late 2026.

cases.reference: The Sun looks weaker in the health part of your chart. The chart suggests taking extra care of your health and rest in late 2026.
